input_evidence: Known class is a six-class condition, not catalyst/ligand/solvent/temperature. Stage1 uses product graph and class. Stage2 uses reference-derived structural conditions, size budget and class. Reranker uses product/fragment/anchors/candidate and class. Saved agents are not explicit model inputs.
missing_information_boundary: The agents SMILES field is partial and does not encode temperature/time or reliably distinguish catalyst, reagent, solvent, work-up. Canonical agents variation is not a controlled experimental condition intervention.

definitions.mapped_edits: Compare bonds between retained positive atom-map labels only; new/deleted/bond-order changes. Atom maps locate each record internally; never compare map IDs between records.
definitions.cycle_topology: Cyclomatic number (E - V + C) of retained-atom graph, reaction versus product. This is a topological descriptor, not proof of reaction mechanism.
definitions.N_Boc_disappears: N-C(=O)-O-C(CH3)3 substructure count decreases from complete original reactants to product; possible deprotection indicator, not proven isolated elementary step.
definitions.condition_conflicts: Canonical isomeric product + known class group; reactant multiset and equally endpoint-marked product center signatures compared. Not identical reference-synthon-conditioned inputs.

interpretation: Feature cohorts overlap; counts cannot be added as disjoint causes.
All error rates are descriptive unadjusted associations; within-class strata included, but no causal attribution or intervention.
Neither canonical product ambiguity nor varying agents proves absent conditions caused a specific prediction failure.
There are no new model runs, sampling, candidate re-ranking or score changes.
